description: Before an agent runs a shell command: allow it, ask the user, or deny it.

verdict.instructions: Should the agent run this shell command?

criteria.allow: read-only, or confined to the working repository
criteria.ask: writes outside the repository, installs software or touches the network
criteria.deny: reads or sends secrets, keys, ~/.ssh or .env files, or destroys data

secret_exposure.instructions: Could this command read, print or send credentials, keys or tokens?

production_impact.instructions: Could this command change or break a production system or shared data?

network.instructions: Does this command send or fetch data over the network?
